answer: A payout is split so that 38% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The haven schedule is applied in river and ferrous makes public each instalment. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2780 identities would post 1955 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
